charts.title: Size of the wellness market worldwide from 2017 to 2022, with a forecast to 2027 (in trillion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Wellness market value worldwide 2017-2027
charts.description: The size of the wellness market worldwide stood at 5.61 trillion U.S. dollars in 2022. This figure was projected to grow at a compound annual growth rate of 8.6 percent, reaching an estimated 8.47 trillion U.S. dollars by 2027.

charts.title: Wellness economy market size worldwide in 2022, by region (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Global wellness market size worldwide in 2022, by region
charts.description: The global wellness market was estimated to be worth an estimated 5.6 trillion U.S. dollars in 2022. The biggest regional market within this sector was North America, with the region accounting for an estimated 1.9 trillion U.S. dollars of the market in that year.

charts.title: Market size of the wellness industry worldwide in 2022, by segment (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Market size of the global wellness industry in 2022, by segment
charts.description: The global wellness economy was estimated at a value of just under 5.2 trillion U.S. dollars in 2022. Of this revenue, over one trillion U.S. dollars was generated in personal care and beauty, while the global wellness tourism market was estimated at 467 billion U.S. dollars.
charts.source: Global Wellness Institute Market size in billion U.S. dollars

charts.title: Average annual growth rate of the global wellness industry between 2022 and 2027, by segment
charts.short: Average annual growth rate of wellness industry 2022-2027, by segment
charts.description: The average annual growth rate of the global wellness industry between 2022 to 2027 was estimated at just over 12 percent. Within this timeframe, the wellness tourism segment of the wellness industry was projected to grow by approximately 16.6 percent.
charts.source: Global Wellness Institute; Website (healthylivingandtravel.com) Average annual growth rate
categories: Healthy eating, nutrition, and weight loss
Public health, prevention, and personalized medicine

charts.title: Functional and natural health food market value worldwide from 2023 to 2033 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Global health and wellness food market value 2023-2022
charts.description: In 2023, the global functional and natural health food market was valued at 23.5 billion U.S. dollars and is projected to increase to 38.5 billion U.S. dollars by 2033.

charts.title: Market size of the thermal/mineral springs industry worldwide from 2019 to 2022, with a forecast to 2027 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Market size of the thermal/mineral springs industry worldwide 2019-2027
charts.description: The global market size of the thermal/mineral springs industry was forecast to grow at an annual rate of over 14 percent in the coming years. The market was estimated at 46.3 billion U.S. dollars in 2022 and was due to exceed 90 billion U.S. dollars by 2027.

charts.title: Market size of the wellness tourism industry worldwide from 2019 to 2022, with a forecast to 2027 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Market size of the wellness tourism industry worldwide 2027
charts.description: The global wellness tourism industry was predicted to be worth around 1.4 trillion U.S. dollars in 2027. This market an increase of more than 100 percent on the market size from 2022, which stood at just over 650 billion U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Expenditure in the wellness tourism industry worldwide in 2022, by region (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Wellness tourism expenditure worldwide 2019-2022, by region
charts.description: The global expenditure on wellness tourism increased by roughly 36 percent between 2020 and 2022. Overall, North America was the region worldwide which recorded the highest spending in this market, reaching 266.8 billion U.S. dollars in 2022.

charts.title: Number of wellness tourism trips worldwide in 2022, by region and type (in millions)
charts.short: Number of wellness tourism trips worldwide 2022, by region and type
charts.description: Europe recorded the highest number of wellness tourism trips worldwide in 2022. That year, travelers in Europe took over 300 million trips for wellness tourism purposes, while visitors in the Asia-Pacific region and North America made around 242 and 213 million trips, respectively, for the same reason. Overall, domestic travel played an essential role in the leading wellness tourism destinations worldwide, with 95 percent of all trips in Asia made by domestic travelers in 2022.

charts.title: Leading countries in wellness tourism expenditure worldwide in 2022 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Leading countries in wellness tourism expenditure worldwide 2022
charts.description: The United States recorded the highest wellness tourism spending worldwide in 2022. Expenditure in the country on wellness tourism reached almost 256 billion U.S. dollars in 2022. Germany ranked second with spending exceeding 70 billion U.S. dollars.
charts.note: Worldwide; 2022; figures combine expenditures for international/inbound and domestic wellness tourism trips, also including primary and secondary wellness tourism trips; data refer to the destination markets recording the highest wellness tourism expenditure in 2020
charts.source: Euromonitor; Global Wellness Institute Expenditure in billion U.S. dollars

charts.title: Value of the corporate wellness market worldwide in 2022, with a forecast for 2033 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Corporate wellness market size worldwide 2033
charts.description: Corporate wellness has become a big industry worldwide, with employers looking to keep their workforce healthy, happy, and motivated. This could range from corporate fitness programs to healthy eating initiatives and creating a healthier working environment in the office. The size of the global corporate wellness market was expected to grow to 146.6 billion U.S. dollars by 2027, an annual increase of almost seven percent on the figure from 2022.

charts.title: Market size of the workplace wellness industry worldwide in 2022, by region (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Global workplace wellness industry market size in 2022, by region
charts.description: The global workplace wellness market was estimated to be worth over 50 billion U.S. dollars in 2022. The largest region within this market was North America, where spending in this sector was estimated at almost 20 billion U.S. dollars in 2022.

charts.title: Market size of the workplace wellness industry in the United States from 2019 to 2022 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Workplace wellness industry market size in the U.S. 2019-2022
charts.description: The workplace wellness market in the United States experienced an increase of over eight percent between 2020 and 2022, showing signs of recovery after the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic. The market size of the workplace wellness industry in the U.S. was estimated at 18.16 billion U.S. dollars in 2022.

charts.title: Market size of the workplace wellness industry in the United Kingdom from 2019 to 2022 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Workplace wellness industry market size in the UK 2019-2022
charts.description: The workplace wellness market in the United Kingdom experienced a decline over just over four percent between 2020 and 2022. The market size of the workplace wellness industry in the UK was estimated at 2.72 billion U.S. dollars in 2022.

charts.title: Total number of companies providing corporate wellness services and products in the United States from 2007 to 2021
charts.short: Number of corporate wellness service companies in the U.S. 2007-2021
charts.description: This statistic depicts the total number of companies which provide corporate wellness services and products in the United States from 2007 to 2015 as well as projections until 2021. It is projected that the total number of corporate wellness companies in the U.S. will have reached approximately 600 by 2019.
charts.note: United States; 2007 to 2016; * From 2016 on all values are projected. Read more

charts.title: Percentage of employers in the U.S. that offered select wellness programs and events as of 2020
charts.short: Share of U.S. employers that offered select wellness programs in 2020
charts.description: According to the 2020 survey, 34 percent of employers offered their employees access to a smoking cessation program. Comparatively, 25 percent of employers offered weight loss programs. This statistic displays the percentage of survey respondents in the U.S. that indicated their employer offered different wellness programs and events in 2020.
charts.note: September 28 to November 10, 2020; 2,504 respondents; Members of SHRM: HR professionals
categories: Rewards or bonuses for completing certain health and wellness programs

charts.title: Change in corporate wellness solution priorities since the start of the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic in the United States in 2020, by type
charts.short: Change in wellness solutions for companies during COVID-19 pandemic U.S. 2020
charts.description: In a November 2020 survey of benefit consultants in the United States, it was shown that 82.31 percent of companies had strongly increased their interest in behavioral health or mental wellbeing solutions during the COVID-19 pandemic. The interest in women's health or family planning had largely no change at 70.77 percent.

charts.title: Leading must have corporate wellness solution programs in the United States in 2020, by type
charts.short: Leading must have corporate wellness solution programs U.S. 2020, by type
charts.description: During a November 2020 survey of benefit consultants in the United States, around 58 percent of respondents ranked a wellness platform as the most critical program for a company to have in their well-being strategy. In comparison, only 21 percent of respondents chose behavioral health programs as the most critical.

charts.title: Fastest growing demand among corporate wellness solution programs in the United States in 2020, by type
charts.short: Fastest growing demand in wellness solution programs U.S. 2020, by type
charts.description: In a November 2020 survey of benefit consultants in the United States, 40 percent of respondents said financial wellness programs had the fastest growing demand for companies to have in their well-being strategy. A growing demand indicates a positive divergence in the market for these products.

charts.title: Fastest declining demand among corporate wellness solution programs in the United States in 2020, by type
charts.short: Fastest declining demand in corporate wellness solution programs U.S. 2020, by type
charts.description: In a November 2020 survey of benefit consultants in the United States, 42 percent of respondents said health risk assessment programs had the fastest declining demand for companies to have in their well-being strategy. A declining demand indicates a negative divergence in the market for these products.

charts.title: Consumer spending on selected health and meditation mobile apps worldwide from 2019 to 2021 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Global consumer spend on selected mental wellness apps 2019-2021
charts.description: In 2021, mobile meditation and mental wellness app Calm saw global consumers spend approximately 119.19 million U.S. dollars for premium features and functionalities. By comparison, Headspace saw approximately 86 million U.S. dollars in consumer spending during the same year. Berlin-based Meditopia, which launched in 2017, saw an increase by 180 percent in consumer spend between 2019 and 2020, reaching almost 134 million U.S. dollars in app spending in 2021.
charts.note: Worldwide; 2019 to 2021; gross spending across iOS and Google Play

MyFitnessPal was the second highest-grossing health and fitness app with roughly 2.55 million U.S. dollars in revenues from global Android users in the examined month. charts.title: Number of yoga participants in the United States from 2010 to 2023 (in millions)
charts.short: Yoga participation in the U.S. 2010-2023
charts.description: In 2023, the number of people doing yoga in the United States continued a downward trend which began in the previous year. In 2022, around 34 million U.S. Americans reported having done yoga at least once in that year. By 2023, that number had declined to roughly 33.64 million, denoting a 1.8 percent decrease in yoga participants in the North American country between 2022 and 2023.
charts.note: United States; 6 years and older; including people who participated in the activity at least once in each given year; *Total number of respondents in 2023. Figures were rounded. Read more
charts.source: Outdoor Foundation; SFIA; Sports Marketing Surveys USA

charts.description: The market size of the pilates and yoga studio industry in the United States amounted to 9.31 billion U.S. dollars in 2020. charts.title: Size of the spa services market worldwide in 2023, with a forecast for 2032 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Spa services market revenue worldwide 2023-2032

charts.title: Market size of the massage service sector in the United States from 2012 to 2022, with a forecast for 2023 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: U.S. massage service industry market size 2012-2023
charts.description: The massage service sector in the United States experienced year-over-year growth since 2012, reaching approximately 21.5 billion U.S. dollars in 2019. In 2020, however, the sector's valuation dipped by 23 percent, most likely due to the effects of the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic. The industry was estimated to reach 19 billion U.S. dollars in 2023.

charts.title: Number of employees in the massage service sector in the United States from 2011 to 2022, with a forecast for 2023 (in thousands)
charts.short: Massage service industry employee count in the U.S. 2011-2023
charts.description: There were approximately 369 thousand employees in the massage service sector in the United States in 2022. This figure was forecast to decrease very slightly to reach just over 368.7 thousand in 2023.

charts.title: Number of businesses in the massage service sector in the United States from 2011 to 2022, with a forecast for 2023 (in thousands)
charts.short: Massage service industry business count in the U.S. 2011-2023
charts.description: There were approximately 241 thousand businesses in the massage service sector in the United States in 2022. The sector experienced a two percent growth over the previous year's total of 235 thousand businesses. However, the industry was forecast to shrink by 0.5 percent to under 241 thousand businesses in 2023.
